concept.concept: An illustrated nervous-looking dog in a hotdog costume with text reading 'I Did Not Consent to This Costume' in hand-lettered style.
concept.audience: Dog owners who dress up their pets for Halloween, primarily women 25-40
concept.rationale: Dog costume humor for Halloween is a proven seller. The consent angle is fresh and viral-adjacent. Broad dog-owner audience overlaps with Halloween shoppers perfectly in the buying window. Mid-level competition.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I Did Not Consent to This Costume" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a small nervous dog wearing a hotdog costume, centered on plain cream background. Dog has wide anxious eyes, furrowed brow, and slightly open mouth expressing reluctance. Body is wrapped in a simple bun shape (tan and brown solid blocks) with a red hotdog sausage body beneath. Four thin legs visible below costume, standing stiffly. Minimize detail: use bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, solid color blocks only—no gradients, no shading, no texture. Limited palette: cream background, tan, brown, red, black, white. High contrast screen-print aesthetic. Single centered composition with generous margins, readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design: I Did Not Consent to This Costume
design.style: Hand-lettered style, loosely irregular capitals and lowercase mix, arched in a slight curve above the dog illustration, black ink solid color, playful but legible, no drop shadows or effects

verdict.reason: The illustrated nervous dog in a hotdog costume is a generic, original concept with no reference to specific trademarks, brands, characters, celebrities, or protected properties. The phrase 'I Did Not Consent to This Costume' is a natural, conversational expression of generic humor commonly associated with pet costume culture. It does not match any known registered slogans or protected marks. The hand-lettered style is a common design treatment. No IP conflicts identified.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads exactly 'I DID NOT CONSENT TO THIS COSTUME' — correctly spelled and complete. The illustration is a generic cartoon dog in a hot dog costume, an original and common humorous motif with no IP concerns. Clean vector-style art, clear background suitable for garment printing, no anatomy issues, no artifacts.

listing.title: Anxious Dog Halloween T-Shirt - Did Not Consent Hotdog Costume Tee
listing.description: A humorous tee that speaks to every dog parent who's wrestled their pup into a Halloween costume. The illustrated nervous-looking dog in a hotdog costume says it all: 'I Did Not Consent to This Costume' in charming hand-lettered style. Relatable for dog owners who love dressing up their pets despite their obvious reluctance. Comfortable and soft for everyday wear or Halloween festivities. Makes a great gift for dog moms and anyone who appreciates pet humor and the reality of costume season. Perfect conversation starter at dog parks and Halloween parties.
